content:
Incident-Bot: @oncall-eng detected sustained queue growth in hosted-us-east-1 (gateway->ingress queues) at 11:37 UTC. GPU pool gpu-pool-7 at 100% allocation; autoscaler failing to create new nodes: "quotaExceeded: insufficient GPUs in region". p95 latency for text.generate is 1.2s -> 6.4s, p99 spiking to 14s. Some requests returning 504s. Paging oncall.

Alex M.: seeing the same in the dashboard. Queues on ingress-controller show 8x baseline, backlog ~72k requests. Token throughput holding but new requests piling.

Priya N.: any customer-facing throttles enabled? We might need emergency shed for low-tier tokens.

Sam R.: autoscaler logs show repeated CreateInstance errors:
```
2026-03-15T11:36:05Z autoscaler: failed to create instance: quotaExceeded: GPUs not available (reason: regional-quota)
2026-03-15T11:36:12Z autoscaler: retrying; backoff 12s
```
Also hitting cloud API rate limits for spot acquisitions.

Jen K.: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variant, 2) enable edge-reroute to dedicated-pool-b (if capacity), 3) apply temporary per-account QPS limits at the gateway.

Alex M.: trying 1) now: flipping fallback policy to allow model: redwood/llama-7b-q8 -> redwood/llama-3b-q4 for compatible signatures. PATCH /v1/policies/fallbacks { enable: true, priority: lower-model } -> response 200.

Incident-Bot: Fallback policy change applied by Alex M. at 11:40 UTC. Monitoring effect.

Priya N.: I'm enabling edge-reroute to dedicated-pool-b for high-cost customers only. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/routing/reroute \
  -d '{"from":"hosted-us-east-1","to":"dedicated-pool-b","filter":"customer_tier:enterprise"}'
```

Sam R.: applied. Traffic to dedicated-pool-b increased by ~12% and those requests are being served with p95 ~200ms. Good.

Alex M.: fallback is reducing token cost but not enough throughput; ingress queue still ~45k backlog. We should enable prefix/KV cache for the most common prompts. Can we hot-enable caching for templates? 

Jen K.: cache toggle: ops-api supports cacheNamespaces. I'm deploying cache for namespace 'chat-templates' now. Doing a rolling config push.

Incident-Bot: Cache rollout started at 11:48 UTC; 20% nodes staged.

Priya N.: estimating customer impact: from logs, ~8% of requests are hitting 504s, primarily from free-tier bursty clients and one large external job. I found a single tenant (tenant-89) making a ramp from 50rps -> 3k rps over 20m.

Sam R.: can we apply immediate rate-limit for tenant-89? Recommend 150 rps.

Alex M.: applying token-bucket limit: `rbac apply-rl tenant-89 150rps` -> success. Monitoring.

Jen K.: also provisioning a manual emergency scale: bump autoscaler max_nodes from 60 -> 90 and permit fallback to spot+on-demand mix. Doing the change.

Incident-Bot: Autoscaler config updated by Jen K. at 11:53 UTC: max_nodes=90, spot_preference=true.

Sam R.: cloud is still returning quota errors for GPUs even with higher max. Looks like account-level region quota cap. Ops-ticket opened with cloud provider: CASE-984321.

Priya N.: while we wait on quota, set up degraded-mode: reject new free-tier requests with 429 and front-load enterprise traffic to dedicated pools. Also enable streaming-only for long responses to reduce queue pressure.

Alex M.: implemented free-tier 429 rule at gateway. Rule id gw-rule-20260315-1. Streaming-only toggle applied to model route.

Incident-Bot: Gateway rule gw-rule-20260315-1 is active. Observed immediate drop in ingress of ~28%.

Sam R.: latency p95 down to 1.1s now, p99 to ~3.2s for routed traffic, but backlog remains ~18k. 504s decreased to 1.2%.

Priya N.: alerting/CS: open incident page, draft message for status page: short note about degraded performance and active mitigations. I'll ping account SRE for tenant-89.

Jen K.: prepping oncall handoff. My shift ends in 40m. Priya, want the handoff? I'll summarize actions in handoff message.

Priya N.: I'll take it. Please include active mitigations list, commands you ran, and pending cloud support ticket.

Jen K.: handoff list:
- fallback policy enabled (llama-7b -> llama-3b) by Alex M.
- reroute enterprise to dedicated-pool-b by Priya N.
- cache namespace chat-templates rollout started.
- rate limit tenant-89 at 150 rps applied by Alex M.
- autoscaler max_nodes bumped to 90 by Jen K. (still hitting cloud quota)
- gateway free-tier 429 rule gw-rule-20260315-1 active
- cloud support CASE-984321 opened, ETA unknown

Incident-Bot: Handoff note pinned. @Priya N. is now oncall for incident at 12:01 UTC.

Priya N.: taking over. Immediate next steps: 1) escalate CASE-984321 to priority-1 with account manager, 2) coordinate with Sales/Customer Success for impacted enterprise customers, 3) keep gateway 429 for free-tier until backlog <5k or cloud quota released.

Sam R.: I'll keep monitoring autoscaler and logs. If cloud quota comes back, we can un-shed free-tier and slowly lift gateway rule.

Alex M.: short-term improvement metrics: p95 overall down from 6.4s to 1.0s for routed traffic; p99 down from 14s to ~3.0s. Request backlog reduced from 72k -> 18k -> 4.6k over 45 minutes of mitigations. Still watching.

Priya N.: thanks team. I'll keep CS & OEMs updated. Marking pager as acknowledged and will update when CASE-984321 gets a response. :thumbsup:

Jen K.: handing off monitoring to Priya and Sam. Leaving playbook references: /playbooks/hosted-queue-exhaustion.md

Incident-Bot: Incident thread closed for active paging at 12:12 UTC; still monitoring. Final note: residual backlog 4.6k, 504s ~0.7%.
